title: Sunday · the flats, April
logline: The mudflats at low tide in April: the channels, the chimney across the bay, a man and a dog small in the middle tier, the tide coming back in the last. The landscapes begin to be the point.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the flats at low tide, channels catching the sky, the cannery chimney far across.

image.prompt: tidal mudflats at low tide with channels catching a pale sky and a distant cannery chimney, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Flats

panels.composition: Tier 2: a man in a chore coat and a dog on the flats, small, prints behind them.

image.prompt: a small man in a canvas chore coat and a dog crossing wet mudflats with a trail of prints behind them, watercolor

panels.name: Two

panels.composition: Tier 3: the same flats an hour on, water in the channels, the prints going under.

image.prompt: the same mudflats with the tide returning into the channels and footprints going under, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Tide
